Obviously be high as fuck. Need a dark room too, as pitch black as it gets. Preferably your bedroom for the sake of lying on the bed, or otherwise anywhere particularly comfy to lie down. Use a pillow if you want, I've found it works well with or without. Also works best if alone, purely because this is entirely about sensory deprivation... constantly 'being on alert' to others in the room just kills it.

Also, you're gonna wanna strip, or leave your underwear on, whatever. I usually sleep naked though, so it's just more comfortable. Also, you want to be able to feel (or rather, not feel) the final step evenly.

Got that room ready? Alright, put on some music. Either headphones, or pretty loud to drown out any ambient noise or traffic. Any music will do, whatever you're in the mood for. I'd recommend something chill like trance music though, at least to start.

Your objective now is to position yourself such that you essentially feel nothing. The best way I've found to do this is to lie on the bed, take a regular, non-fitted bed sheet (so basically just a big, flat rectangle of cloth), and drape it over you.

Sit up, and pull the sheet up over your legs. You want as few wrinkles as possible... you can feel wrinkles when you're lying there. As you lie back, pull the sheet up, over your head. I like to lay flat on my back with my arms at my sides, or behind my head, or whatever. Try to avoid having one of your body parts being pressed on or brushed by another... remember, the objective is to feel nothing.

So, you've pulled this sheet above your head, in the pitch black(having cellphone light on until you reach your head could be useful), with loud music.

What you should feel is the cloth perfectly evenly over every inch of your skin. Ideally, no part of your body should feel 'different' than the rest. Everything warm, everything dark, music blotting out traffic, and the gentle feel of cloth evenly distributed over your entire body. You'll know what I'm talking about when you get to this point, it's very easy to feel if there's a big wrinkle in the cloth over your leg or whatever. It'll take a bit of trial and error and shuffling around for a few minutes to kinda tug the sheet around and get it nice and even.

Now... lie back, and absorb yourself into the music. Eyes open or closed, at this point, there should literally be no visible difference. Just let your mind wander, and you should see all kinds of colours or shapes kinda forming in your vision. You're essentially creating CEV's, or closed-eye visuals.

Then, try focusing on those colours and shapes, let your mind wander and shape them, do whatever it is your mind decides to do. There's been a number of times where I've felt like I'm rocketing through a tunnel, passing through hundreds of 'circles'. I've pictured all kinds of random things... drew a few of them.

Oh, yeah, big tip. Keep a notepad beside you. It may involve killing the illusion since you have to move, but I've found I get my best ideas by doing things like this. Like... literally, I've changed my life significantly for the better. I'm eating healthier, regular exercise, more creative, etc. Also, having the vape or something nearby might be good for top-ups.

But yeah... enjoy. I dunno, it requires a lot of setup, and may take a few attempts to kinda 'pull off' (and try not to be TOO tired, otherwise you'll just fall asleep :P ), but... it's seriously fun and amazing if you can get it to work.
